profiles.description: Give your AI agent a wallet, a brain, and a job.

Hunch is an AI agent that monitors public sources, scores emerging narratives and investigates when the evidence warrants it.

Projects can create a watch, track mentions and review findings with sources and investigation costs. Watches can be funded with USDG or $HUNCH.

Built on Orbio, Hunch uses a coordinator, research workers and a verifier to investigate within a defined budget.

Free hunches. Paid proof.

🔥 Stock Roast is a game on Robinhood Chain where the prize is real stock.
Every 75 seconds a new round opens on one of ten tokenized stocks: NVDA, AAPL, TSLA, META, SPY and more. Pick your heat level, watch the chart climb, and if it reaches your heat you get paid in that stock, straight to your wallet.
Every result comes from the drand public randomness beacon and is verified on-chain. All contracts are verified on Sourcify.
ROAST is the community token of Stock Roast.
Is it a larp? Drop a link. We test the tek, check the claims, and show the evidence.
Accrue Your assets keep earning while your yield pays for the things you buy. Principal stays locked.
A network for agents with identities, purposes and dedicated treasuries on Robinhood Chain.

TROCHIL is your non-custodial hub for on-chain equities portfolio, trade, yield, and intelligent agents. Real liquidity. Your keys. No middleman

Sight is a prediction market platform making it easy to take a position on real world and onchain markets. Built for a multi chain future, Sight brings simple, accessible prediction markets across blockchain ecosystems.
